title: Madame X
description: A young lawyer (John Beal) defends an alcoholic woman (Gladys George) for murder, unaware she is his mother.

title: Monsieur Hulot's Holiday
description: A hapless French tourist attempts to make the most of his disastrous vacation as he causes havoc at a seaside resort hotel.

title: Let No Man Write My Epitaph
description: An executed hoodlum's drug-addicted widow (Shelley Winters) raises her pianist son (James Darren) in a Chicago slum.

title: Escape From the Planet of the Apes
description: Cornelius (Roddy McDowall), Zira (Kim Hunter) and Milo, apes from the future, escape to 1970s Los Angeles and pose a threat.

title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
description: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the Enterprise crew battle an old foe (Ricardo Montalban) who blames Kirk for the death of his wife.

title: Sol Madrid
description: An undercover drug agent (David McCallum) tracks a former mobster to Acapulco and finds a heroin operation.

title: The Train Robbers
description: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo.

title: Camille
description: A glamorous courtesan (Alla Nazimova) ends her affair with a young man (Rudolph Valentino) at the request of his father.

title: Camille
description: Marguerite is a well-kept courtesan of the rich and influential Baron de Varville, but when a promising young man falls in love with her, his sincere adoration causes her to question her comfortable life.

title: The Unholy Three
description: A side-show ventriloquist (Lon Chaney) forms an underground trio with a strongman and a midget.

title: The Unholy Three
description: A ventriloquist (Lon Chaney) works a pet-shop scam with a carnival pickpocket (Lila Lee), midget and strongman.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: March won an Oscar for his portrayal of the scientist whose experiments bring out a hideous side of his personality.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: March won an Oscar for his portrayal of the scientist whose experiments bring out a hideous side of his personality.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
description: Grotesque bell-ringer Quasimodo (Lon Chaney) rescues Gypsy Esmeralda (Patsy Ruth Miller) from a mob in medieval Paris.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
description: Grotesque bell-ringer Quasimodo (Charles Laughton) saves Gypsy Esmeralda (Maureen O'Hara) from a mob and a corrupt priest (Sir Cedric Hardwicke) in medieval Paris.

title: The Three Musketeers
description: D'Artagnan (Douglas Fairbanks) helps Athos (Leon Barry), Porthos (George Siegmann) and Aramis foil Cardinal Richelieu's plot to besmirch the queen.

title: The Mark of Zorro
description: In old Spanish California, the son of a California aristocrat disguises himself as a daring swordsman to defend the honor of his people.

title: The Sea Hawk
description: Sold into slavery by his brother (Lloyd Hughes), an English nobleman (Milton Sills) becomes a pirate out for revenge.

title: The Beloved Rogue
description: Jaunty poet Francois Villon (John Barrymore) falls from royal grace, then rescues Louis XI's (Conrad Veidt) ward (Marceline Day).

title: Scaramouche
description: An 18th-century Frenchman poses as a clown and meets a master swordsman in a duel of revenge.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: An Englishman with an uncanny resemblance to a foreign king is pressed into duty when the monarch is kidnapped.

title: Bathing Beauty
description: A goofy songwriter (Red Skelton) enrolls at a women's college to be near his aquatic sweetheart (Esther Williams).

title: The Harvey Girls
description: A mail-order bride (Judy Garland) stops in a frontier gambler's (John Hodiak) town to work as a waitress.

title: Cass Timberlane
description: Cass Timberlane, a cultured judge in a small town, falls for working-class girl Virginia Jinny Marshland, and his life unravels after she has an affair.

title: Key to the City
description: A New England mayor (Loretta Young) and a California mayor (Clark Gable) clash and flirt at a convention in San Francisco.

title: Show Boat
description: The captain's daughter (Kathryn Grayson) marries a gambler (Howard Keel) who turns performer on a Mississippi riverboat.

title: Young Bess
description: Henry VIII's (Charles Laughton) daughter Elizabeth (Jean Simmons) has a forbidden romance with naval hero Thomas Seymour (Stewart Granger).

title: The Day the Earth Caught Fire
description: British reporters and a weatherwoman get the facts after U.S./Soviet same-day nuclear tests.

title: Silent Running
description: A renegade botanist (Bruce Dern) kills his space-station shipmates (Cliff Potts, Ron Rifkin) to save his garden of earthly vegetation.

title: No Blade of Grass
description: A Londoner (Nigel Davenport) leads his wife (Jean Wallace) and family through anarchy after a virus wipes out the world's crops.

title: Them!
description: Bug experts (Edmund Gwenn, Joan Weldon), a state trooper (James Whitmore) and an FBI agent track giant mutant ants from New Mexico to Los Angeles.

title: The Swarm
description: A scientist (Michael Caine) and an Air Force general (Richard Widmark) trick killer bees away from Houston.

title: MGM Parade
description:

Clip of Judy Garland and Gene Kelly in "For Me and My Gal"; host George Murphy.

title: Little Women
description: Based on the story by Louisa May Alcott. The four March sisters forge unbreakable emotional ties during the Civil War.

title: Summertime
description: A married art dealer (Rossano Brazzi) sweeps an Ohio secretary (Katharine Hepburn) off her feet in Venice.

title: South Pacific
description: Navy nurse Nellie (Mitzi Gaynor) falls for plantation-owner Emile (Rossano Brazzi), who accepts a top-secret World War II mission.

title: Count Your Blessings
description: An Englishwoman (Deborah Kerr) waits about nine years for her wayward French husband (Rossano Brazzi) to return from World War II.

title: Light in the Piazza
description: An American (Olivia de Havilland) allows her mentally impaired daughter (Yvette Mimieux) to marry a rich young man in Florence.

title: Rome Adventure
description: An art student (Troy Donahue), his ex-girlfriend (Angie Dickinson), a librarian (Suzanne Pleshette) and a local charmer cross paths in Italy.

title: The Bobo
description: An impresario will let a clumsy matador (Peter Sellers) sing at his theater if he seduces the biggest flirt (Britt Ekland) in Barcelona.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: The Nanny
description: A bratty British boy accuses his frumpy nanny (Bette Davis) of awful things.

title: The Honeymoon Killers
description: After meeting through a lonely hearts club, Martha Beck (Shirley Stoler) and Ray Fernandez (Tony Lo Bianco) swindle and murder rich, lonely women.

title: Cast a Dark Shadow
description: An Englishman (Dirk Bogarde) gets away with killing his rich old wife, then tries it with a savvy widow (Margaret Lockwood).

title: Diabolique
description: A wife (Vera Clouzot) and a mistress (Simone Signoret) conspire to murder the brutal headmaster (Paul Meurisse) of a school for boys, then the body disappears.

title: Obsession
description: A London psychiatrist suspects that his wife is having yet another affair; when he confirms it, he takes her lover prisoner and taunts his wife about the other man's condition.
